children: Axiom Intelligence Acquisition Corp 1's earnings declined year over year as lower interest earned on Trust Account investments was partly offset by higher general and administrative expenses. The company said it has not begun operations and expects no operating revenue until after completing a business combination.
: The proposed business combination, agreed to in May 2026, remains subject to shareholder approval and other customary closing conditions.
: Cash outside the Trust Account was $166,607 and the company reported a $1,094,392 working capital deficit as of September 30, 2026.
: Management said substantial doubt exists about the company’s ability to continue as a going concern, citing insufficient liquidity and costs to pursue an acquisition.
